newsitem.title: CHINA: Easyknit raises HK$105 mln in shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Easyknit raises HK$105 mln in shr issue.

text.p: Easyknit International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to place 196.26 million new shares at HK$0.54 each with eight independent investors, raising net proceeds of about HK$104.8 million.

The company said in a statement it would use about HK$95 million to set up about 10 "Library" retail chain stores in Taiwan and about HK$9.8 million to set up a representative office in Taipei for its Library chain stores.
Koon Wing Yee together with Magical Profits Ltd will remain the single largest shareholder of the company after the deal, with a 46.1 percent stake compared with a current 50 percent.
Easyknit said the new shares represent about 8.6 percent of its existing share capital and about 7.9 percent of its enlarged share capital.
The subscription price represents a discount of 10 percent to Tuesday's closing price of HK$0.60 per share.
Easyknit's Library chain stores are mainly involved in the sale of casual ladies wear. About 10 staff will be employed in the representative office in Taipei, Easyknit said.
Eight stores are currently in operation in Hong Kong.
